title: データベース
subtitle: Database System
educationalGoal:
A database is a system that shares, updates, and reuses data between multiple applications, thereby ensuring data consistency.
 In this course, students learn the fundamental theory of a relational database, database design, Structured Query Language (SQL), which is the language used for database management, and practical database operations using an actual database management system.
advice:
There are three essential abilities needed to manage a database:

(1)	The ability to handle SQL.
(2)	The ability to ensure data consistency based on the concept of normal form, primary key, and foreign key, etc.
(3)	The ability to design a database application system using transactions.

In this course we mainly focused on (1) and (2), but (3) will be also mentioned in the later classes.

Since SQL is used for comprehensive database operations such as design, handling, and/or maintenance, it will be necessary to polish student SQL management skills by providing them with significant amounts of experience.

With that point in mind, students will be required to connect with and use our database server and then use it to manipulate their own databases in order to foster skills and knowledge related to the operation and management of a relational database.
requiredKnowledge: Students are expected to have acquired fundamental knowledge related to computers via other courses such as “Information Technology Basic” or “Introduction to Server Management”
